capability.summary: Non-thinking coding model with a smaller sparse-expert design.
capability.problem_space: Coding model for repository editing and development tools. Applicable tasks include repository code editing, debugging, refactoring, test implementation, tool-assisted programming. Accepts text input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions. Published distinction: The documented architecture has 30.5 billion total and 3.3 billion active parameters. It uses a coding-oriented function-call format; parser and gateway compatibility must be verified independently.

env_requirements: GPU >= 24GB VRAM (Local Deployment) or API Key (Cloud)
constraint.io_signature: Input modalities: text | Output modalities: text. Gateway transport support requires verification.
